name: harder-better-faster-stronger
about: Daft Punk - Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger (Discovery, 2001), official audio YouTube yydNF8tuVmU; Songsterr tab 24122. v1 setup: tab parts on chirp's French-house palette (909 kit, house-chord stabs, juno pad, moog-seq bass, a formant talk-box lead for the robot vocal). Tempo 123.454 BPM and bar 1 at 1.4395 s fitted to the drum stem's kicks (+-3 ms residual over the song): the tab notates the groove half a beat off the bar line (kick at beat 0.5); the record's first kick is at 5.56 s (bar 3).
